#### Description
Addition of functions that utilize node endpoint API. Including Creation, Read, Update, Delete, and Stop.
These functions can be found in Api/Api.cs

Addition of Nodes.cs that contains a new Node Obj as well as two wrapper classes for the rest api responses.
This new set of classes can be found at Common/API/Nodes.cs

Also created a set of tests related to these new functions that prove the use of API
Tests found at  Tests/API/NodeTests.cs

#### Related Issue
Update API/CLI to include Nodes Endpoints. Closes #4524

#### Motivation and Context
With the addition of organizations we added a set of endpoints to the API that allows CRUD of nodes.

#### Requires Documentation Change
An update to API documentation may be necessary. Mostly just the new functions and their params. The code itself contains plenty of comments and well defined xml on this information.

#### How Has This Been Tested?
<!--- Please describe in detail how you tested your changes. -->
<!--- Include details of your testing environment, and the tests you ran to -->
<!--- see how your change affects other areas of the code, etc. -->

Created a new set of tests as this does not relate to other parts of the code base. Reference Tests/API/NodeTests.cs
- CreateNewNode : Test for creating a New Node
- CRUDNodes: Create, Read, Update, and Delete a node! (Has three cases, in which a node is created for each targeted group i.e. Backtesting, Research, Live)
- SkuIsGeneratedCorrectly: Tests the GetSKU function from Node class, allows user to get a sku dependent on what config they want.
- ReadAndStop: Reads all the nodes for the testOrg and stops any that are running. 
- ReadNode: Reads all the nodes for the testOrg

issue_context.title: Update API/CLI to include Nodes Endpoints
issue_context.body:
#### Expected Behavior
API included the ability to add and remove nodes.
https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Api/Api.cs
https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Tests/API/ApiTests.cs

CLI Application Includes Node Expansion:
https://github.com/QuantConnect/quantconnect-cli/tree/master/src/commands

#### Actual Behavior
No Node API CRUD support.

#### Potential Solution
Update API for Nodes. 

```
Endpoint api/v2/nodes/create
post:{
	name: 'new node name',
	organizationId : 'organization hash',
	sku: 'B8-1'  -> internally know as node name
	projectId?: 1233 -> Will automatically add the new node to the project (optional)
}

Endpoint api/v2/nodes/read
post:{
	organizationId : 'organization hash',
}

Endpoint api/v2/nodes/stop
post:{
	nodeId: 'node hash',
	organizationId : 'organization hash',
}

Endpoint api/v2/nodes/delete
post:{
	nodeId: 'node hash',
	organizationId : 'organization hash',
}

Endpoint api/v2/nodes/update
post:{
	nodeId : 'node hash',
	name: 'new node name',
	organizationId : 'organization hash',
}

response: {success : true/false, message: ""}
```




#### Checklist

comments:
I can handle the CLI commands, but I got two blocking questions:
- What does `organizationId` refer to? I know projects have an `organizationId`, but as far as I know users normally never see that id and there is no endpoint to retrieve the organizations a user is in.
- The endpoints listed here don't seem to be working? I grabbed the `organizationId` of one of my projects and ran `qcli api:post --body '{ "organizationId": "<id>" }' nodes/read`, but that simply returned the error page you get when you browse to [https://www.quantconnect.com/api/v2/nodes/read](https://www.quantconnect.com/api/v2/nodes/read) with your browser.

@jmerle thank you Jasper we'll take you up on that -- let us get the prototype and tests done to debug all the edge cases and then will be ready for CLI. 

An organization is a new concept in QuantConnect to separate out projects and resources and allow teams to collaborate better on the platform. We'll launch it later this week.

I have added the `nodes:list`, `nodes:stop`, `nodes:update` and `nodes:delete` commands to the CLI. I also attempted to create a `nodes:create` command, but the `nodes/create` endpoint always responds with an HTTP 500 error when seemingly valid input is given (it responds with descriptive error messages when an invalid SKU is given though).

In my opinion it should be fine without a `nodes:create` command for now, so all actions that can increase an organization's billing are performed in the web interface where the billing change is better visible than in a CLI.

~I'm planning to release this in 1.1.0 in about 12 hours~ I released this in [1.1.0](https://github.com/QuantConnect/quantconnect-cli/releases/tag/v1.1.0) along with some other changes I made in the past few weeks.
